title: refAInery agent personality v1
description: Optional personality overlay on a harness-owned agent role, not a running agent or model selection. Must not contain credentials.

id.description: Stable personality identity, unique within the loaded configuration. File basename must equal this ID; the loader enforces both rules.

instructions.description: Additional personality guidance, preserved without trimming or rewriting. Supplements rather than replaces the harness role contract. Instructions are not a permissions boundary.

availableTools.description: Optional legacy capability restriction. Omission uses the harness role tools. Explicit lists must be a subset of role tools and retain required workflow tools; the backend enforces this policy.
